rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that someone acts in response to something.

example.english: They react to the arrangement by changing their approach right away.
example.traditional: 佢對呢個安排有反應，仲即刻改咗做法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 faan2 jing3 zung6 zik1 hak1 goi2 zo2 zou6 faat3

rows.note: Use this specifically when chemicals or other substances undergo a chemical reaction.

example.english: The two cleaning products can react chemically when mixed, so do not experiment.
example.traditional: 兩種清潔劑溝埋會起化學反應，千祈唔好亂試。
example.jyutping: loeng5 zung2 cing1 git3 zai1 gau1 maai4 wui5 hei2 faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 lyun6 si3
